Taking the stage

Playing on the island is free, and there is no fee at any point in the process. Register a Second Life account — also free — turn up, and claim a slot. Booking is a conversation on the Discord, not a payment.

  • Book a slot
  • Island Discord
  • Teleport
  • Web map
  • Timetable

6 of these entries are not answering. The pages still exist and still say what the address should be, because a roster that quietly drops a dead act is worse than one that shows the wound. What each one needs is written in its own page.
